Noah P.: hey folks, second day here. trying to finish onboarding but stuck on a couple items: Okta prompts to enroll MFA but my YubiKey isn't recognized (USB-C on a Mac). Also Google Drive says I don't have permissions to the 'eng/onboarding' folder. 1Password web shows 'Account pending assignment'. anyone know the right order to fix this?
Maya (IT): welcome Noah! :wave: share your email and we'll check provisioning and device enrollment. also, which macOS version? some older macOS + Chrome have WebAuthn quirks.
Noah P.: noah.p@redwood.com, macOS 13.6, using Chrome 118. YubiKey model: YubiKey 5C Nano.
Access Bot: Provisioning status for noah.p@redwood.com: SCIM: complete; Groups: synced; MFA: unenrolled; 1Password: unassigned
Maya (IT): thanks. first, we'll manually assign the 1Password account. second, we can enroll WebAuthn for your YubiKey from Okta admin. If that fails we'll try Touch ID fallback.
Evan S.: fyi ops policy requires adding YubiKey to allowlist for WebAuthn on the corp tenant. Maya, want me to toggle the allowlist?
Maya (IT): yes please, Evan. toggling now.
Ops Bot: WebAuthn allowlist updated by Evan S. (audit id AW-8821).
Noah P.: tried enrolling WebAuthn after the allowlist update; browser shows "Cannot register authenticator: NotAllowedError". I plugged the YubiKey in and tapped it.
Maya (IT): NotAllowedError usually means Chrome blocked the prompt. Try in Safari (WebAuthn is more stable). Also confirm "Use Security Key" option is enabled in Okta profile page.
Noah P.: switched to Safari, got a browser prompt, tapped the key, enrollment succeeded! Nice.
Access Bot: 1Password assigned to noah.p@redwood.com by Maya (IT).
Noah P.: 1Password SSO works now. Docs still says no access to eng/onboarding folder.
Maya (IT): eng folder is group-restricted. I see you're missing eng-new-hires group membership. I'll add you.
Maya (IT): added to eng-new-hires and eng-2026. wait a couple minutes for Drive ACLs to update.
Ops Bot: Google Drive ACLs updated for noah.p@redwood.com (groups added: eng-new-hires, eng-2026).
Noah P.: I can open eng/onboarding now, and the onboarding checklist doc is visible. Everything working. Thanks all! :tada:
Maya (IT): great. Leaving this thread open for 24h in case of regressions. If you need elevated GitHub access or to join the infra rotation, DM Evan and I.
Noah P.: will do, thanks for the quick help! :smile:
